answer_1.outputs: Sentences rewritten to exhibit desired sentiment and formality (style-transferred text)

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance of our model and the baselines based on the style control, content preservation and fluency. To measure the accuracy of style transfer, we train two Fasttext classifiers... We also calculate BLEU score between the transferred sentence and the input sentence (self-BLEU) and BLEU score between the transferred sentence and the human reference (ref-BLEU). To measure the fluency of the text, we calculate perplexity assigned to the generated text sequence by a language model trained on the train corpus.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to evaluate the model outputs across various dimensions such as content preservation, style control, fluency, and overall transfer quality. ... Each value represents the average of rating between 1 (Very bad) and 5 (Very good).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated sentence on a 1‑5 scale for content preservation, style control, fluency, and overall transfer quality.
